title: Pontotoc County schools set Dec. 2 meeting for bidders on school internet equipment
excerpt: The district will open bids Dec. 15. Vendors must attend the Dec. 2 meeting to qualify and can send an optional letter of intent by Dec. 1.
locality: Pontotoc County School District, Pontotoc, Mississippi.

paragraphs.text: Companies seeking to supply internet equipment and services to Pontotoc County schools must attend a vendor meeting at 1 p.m. Wednesday, Dec. 2. The district will take questions at its office at 354 Center Ridge Drive in Pontotoc, where it will open bids on Tuesday, Dec. 15.

There is an earlier date for vendors who want advance notice of a change to the meeting. The district asks them to submit an optional letter of intent by 11:59 p.m. Tuesday, Dec. 1. The letter puts a vendor on the notification list if the meeting time changes and leaves the decision to submit a bid open.

Sealed bids must reach the district by 2:30 p.m. Dec. 15, when the opening begins in the board room. Vendors can mail or hand-deliver a sealed envelope marked for the 2027 E-Rate bid, or submit a Category Two bid electronically through Central Bidding. The district’s request for proposals includes the full envelope instructions.

The district filed the request under the federal E-Rate program. Its Category Two funding helps schools pay for eligible connections that distribute broadband inside school buildings. The county’s public filing is listed under application number 270003006.
